Description: Independent retained manual Amplify frontend for one Game Studio tenant/environment. No repository token, autobuild, domain mutation or paid model is configured.

        value: "nosniff"

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Manual artifact hosting with independent tenant origin and no source credentials.
must: Autobuild and preview creation stay disabled; publish only reviewed source.
Initial embed ancestor list is empty; release artifacts contain generated exact-host headers.
Keep creator, OAuth and settings paths non-frameable.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Stable manual release branch whose origin is registered once in Core.
must: Do not delete or rename an origin already registered in Core.
No automatic build or pull-request preview deployment.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Private immutable source archives for this installation releases only.
must: Do not reuse another application artifact bucket or store runtime client secrets.
Encrypt, block public access, require TLS, retain artifacts for explicit rollback.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: TLS-only access to the private release bucket.
must: This deny does not create anonymous read access.

Origin.Description: Exact generated origin to register in Core before API release.

ArtifactBucket.Description: Dedicated private code artifact bucket for the API release.
